entities.summary: Keshon Montae Gilbert is an American basketball player for the Atlanta Hawks of the National Basketball Association, on a two-way contract with the College Park Skyhawks of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the UNLV Runnin' Rebels and the Iowa State Cyclones.
